problem: The sample `ls dist/` output names a wheel for a package called python_code_intelligence_mcp, the project's old name. pyproject.toml's [project] name is pyeye-mcp, so `uv build` produces a pyeye_mcp-<version> wheel and a reader comparing their output to this one will think the build went wrong.
replacement: Drop the hard-coded wheel filename and say only that the wheel and sdist in dist/ carry the tag's version with no .dev or local suffix (or show a placeholder such as `<dist-name>-<version>-py3-none-any.whl`).
subject: python_code_intelligence_mcp-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl

problem: The command runs bare `python`. pyeye is installed only in the uv-managed .venv, so outside an activated venv this fails with ModuleNotFoundError. The line just above it uses `uv run python -m setuptools_scm`.
replacement: uv run python -c "from pyeye import __version__; print(__version__)"
subject: python -c "from pyeye import __version__; print(__version__)"
